Pre-Modeling Analysis — Housing Prices in 4 HSR Districts

Banqiao, Zuoying, Taoyuan, Zhubei · 2024Q4 ~ 2026Q1 · Cleaned 9,731 transactions

targetvariable: Total Price (10K) · modeltarget R²>0.9, SMAPE<10%

Overview Descriptive Stats Price Index Internal Factors External Factors Multicollinearity Modeling Advice Data Cleaning Log Banqiao Model Taoyuan Model Zuoying Model Zhubei Model Cross-Region

1. Overview

This study covers 4 HSR districts (Banqiao, Zuoying, Taoyuan, Zhubei), collecting 2024Q4 ~ 2026Q1 with 9,783 raw transaction records. After manual review removed 52 anomalies, retaining 9,731, combined with 1,427 POIs and quarterly price indices, to build the prediction feature set.

Avg Price by Age Group

All 4 districts show a clear age→ total price negative correlation. But Banqiao's 11–20 yr homes are surprisingly higher than 6–10 yr, possibly due to premium-location effects.

3. Price Index Time Series

Observation: Zhubei has the highest price index (avg 248), then Taoyuan (188), Zuoying (176), Banqiao lowest (160). But Banqiao'sTotal Priceis not the lowest — showing the price index is "relative to base period", not linear with absolute price.

4. Internal Factors vs Total Price

Correlation Heatmap (Pearson)

Key Scatter Plots

Total Area vs Total Price

Age vs Total Price

Modeling Evidence:
  • area is the dominant factor (overall r=0.775),must include.
  • has_parking, bathrooms are next strongest positive factors.
  • age is the strongest negative factor.
  • main_ratio is significant in Zuoying/Taoyuan but near-zero in Banqiao — reflecting building style differences.
  • floor_ratio(floor/total_floors) overall correlation is weak; recommend dropping or using floor quantile.

5. External Factors vs Total Price

Distance Feature Correlation Heatmap

HSR Distance vs Total Price

Observations & Evidence:
  • HSR Distance: Zhubei most sensitive (r=-0.35), Taoyuan next (-0.12), Zuoying barely related (-0.04). This makes sense: Zhubei and Taoyuan are HSR new towns tightly tied to the station; Zuoying has additional MRT and mature commercial zones diluting the effect.
  • Nearest Commercial Distance: Overall negative correlation — closer to commercial zones, higher price. Strongest in Taoyuan.
  • Price Index: overall r=0.122,Cross-Regioneffective. But within-region quarterly variation is small. For per-region models the price index may not be strong; for the combined model it should be kept.

6. Multicollinearity Check

Internal FactorsCross-correlation Matrix:

Collinearity to Address: has_building vs main_ratio(r=0.85), with parking vs Total Area(r=0.71), bathrooms vs Total Area(r=0.66), floor vs total_floors(r=0.63).
Recommendation: Use Lasso, Ridge, or tree models (Random Forest / XGBoost) to handle collinearity automatically.

Recommended Feature List

Core Internal Factors: Total Area_ping has_parking bathrooms age total_floors floor bedrooms main_ratio_pct

Core External Factors: dist_HSR dist_min_commercial cnt_500m_commercial cnt_1km_convenience cnt_1km_school Price Index(combined model only)

Recommend Removing/Merging: floor_ratio, has_building (collinear with main_ratio), has_land (low variance).

Strategy

  • Model: Compare (1) Lasso/Ridge regression (2) Random Forest (3) XGBoost / LightGBM.
  • Modeling Architecture: Per-region models (4) + combined model with district one-hot (1), totaling 5 modelcomparison.
  • Avoid Overfitting: 5-fold CV, early stopping, feature filtering, SHAP.
  • Target Transform: Log-transform target, exp back after prediction — significantly reduces SMAPE.

Analyzing which features matter across all districts, which only matter in specific districts, and why Taoyuan/Zhubei met the goals while Banqiao/Zuoying did not.

13.7 Why Some Districts Meet the Goals

Avg Price Index vs R²

Sample Size vs R²

Four Observations:
  1. Higher Price Index ≠ Higher R²: Zhubei index 248 (highest), R²=0.918; Banqiao 160 (lowest), R²=0.834. Absolute price is not the key.
  2. More Samples ≠ Higher R²: Taoyuan 3640 records R²=0.943; Banqiao 3167 only 0.834; Zhubei fewest (1378) yet R²=0.918.
  3. The real determinants are data linearity and outlier density: Banqiao has many extreme luxury (120M) → lower R²; Taoyuan smooth distribution → highest R².
  4. Common Core: log_area, area_per_room, main_ratio, area_x_age, price_idx_x_area. With limited budget/time, prioritize these 5.

13.8 Core Modeling Concepts

One research goal is to identify model relationships for similar regions. Summary:
  • "HSR new town" type (Taoyuan, Zhubei): dist_HSR is the strongest factor; use HSR distance as the core feature, MRT can be omitted. Similar regions (Yunlin-Huwei, Chiayi-Taibao) can apply the same architecture.
  • "Mature urban" type (Banqiao, Zuoying): MRT distance + amenity density (cnt_500m series) dominate, HSR less important; keep MRT and commercial. Taichung-Wuri, Tainan-Guiren can apply similar logic.
  • Luxury Handling: All 4 set HIGH_THRESHOLD (Banqiao 1500, Taoyuan 1500, Zuoying 2000, Zhubei 3000); ResidBooster trains a 2nd-stage on P90+ samples, reducing high-price errors by 0.5-1%.
  • Rolling Avg Price Feature roll_unit_price_3m: captures market heat in the same ring 3 months ago, avoiding future leakage. Zhubei relies most (importance #2), reflecting Liujia HSR's distinct rhythm.
